title: Bound exact local retrieval work for the complete audio corpus
description: Purpose: make the accepted exact local semantic endpoint usable for the complete27714-region library without weakening current visibility/revision guards. Prereq accepted0bbbff and actual full publication. Allowed crates/apricity-cli/src/semantic.rs and route initialization plus native tests, dedicated performance verification script/docs only. Exclude cloud/browser/analysis/embedding changes and sibling Virtuus. Cache only immutable parsed+validated published vectors, keyed by authoritative file replacement metadata; changed/corrupt corpus must reload/failclosed, never return prior cached corpus. Current canonical entities remain checked every request; no cross-request sample/clip/visibility cache. Score all vectors exactly and tie semanticId ascending, but stop canonical hydration once requested valid hit limit is filled; filteredCount counts candidates actually rejected during this request, not a full-corpus freshness audit. Publication coverage remains authoritative corpus audit. Execute deterministic RED tests for repeated parse/cache invalidation/corrupt replacement/current edit and bounded canonical lookup work; compare exact results to fixed-vector full baseline. Real browser query against full real corpus before claiming performance; command must report errors/timeouts, no skipped model pass. Temporary local runtime restart must be announced and browser-verified; preserve user test assets, build verification to separate output directory. Terra cannot commit/push/close/deploy; supervisor reruns before landing. Loading/error/cancellation unchanged. Report exact diffs RED/GREEN counts real timing and unresolved states.
